title: Here’s Why Staples Should Be Your Go-To for Holiday Photos and Last-Minute Gifts
gist: A promotional, affiliate-linked Wired review recommending Staples for holiday photo gifts and business printing, arguing in-store human help, proofs and same-day pickup beat online-only services. Thin on hard data; mildly notes Gen Z interest in printed matter.

insights.claim: The author argues Staples' main edge over online-only print services is in-store staff who can catch file problems and print proofs before the job is run.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Physical-store service is positioned as Staples' differentiator in print, a possible retail moat versus online-only rivals.

insights.claim: Staples offers same-day pickup for in-store orders of five or fewer items, while larger orders must be delivered; a production-center route with in-person proof approval improves quality but can take several days to two weeks.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Shows a speed-versus-quality tradeoff in the service tiers.
insights.locator: Want to really step up your game?

insights.claim: Staples print quality lags dedicated photo services Mpix and Printique, but is judged good for the price, as both rivals cost more.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Staples competes as a value option rather than a premium one in photo printing.
insights.locator: The photo options, like mounted prints

insights.claim: The author claims Gen Z is embracing printed matter while eschewing digital media, and that people react far more strongly to a photo book than to an Instagram post.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Anecdotal support for a niche physical-keepsake and print revival tailwind, not backed by data.

insights.claim: The author, restarting a business, printed business cards first, before any social media account, arguing offline success requires print.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Small-business print demand (cards, banners, signs) persists as a steady revenue line for office retailers.
insights.locator: Staples is also a great place

insights.claim: The article carries affiliate disclosure and Prime Day deal promotion, so the recommendation is commercially linked and should be read as promotional.
insights.speaker: Wired
insights.so_what: Treat as low-signal marketing content for investment purposes.
